purpose: Candidate evidence-aware schema for methodology review. The production calculator does not read this file.

principles.observedVsModelled: Observed data, model assumptions and opportunity-cost benchmarks must remain distinct.
principles.historicalPeriods: Use annual observations where comparable series exist; never represent current annual rates multiplied backward through time as observed history.
principles.uncertainty: Ranges and coverage limits should remain visible rather than being collapsed into false precision.
principles.currency: Historical sums require an explicit nominal/constant/current-USD rule before production use.

globalMilitaryExpenditure.nextAction: Choose currency basis for historical series, ingest annual SIPRI data, then update runtime.

source.coverageNote: UCDP yearly armed-conflict datasets cover 1946-2025; multiple organized-violence and battle-related-death series have strongest consistent coverage from 1989 onward.

directConflictDeaths.nextAction: Define exact death categories and a consistent pre-1989 coverage rule before ingesting annual observations.

indirectDeathMultiplier.nextAction: Test whether a global multiplier is defensible. Prefer scenario ranges with uncertainty if retained.

infrastructureDamage.nextAction: Either source a defensible global model with uncertainty or move this metric to an explicitly labelled scenario layer.

averageYearsOfLifeLost.nextAction: Define population, method and source; otherwise remove the universal scalar.

economicValuePerDeath.nextAction: Review whether monetised mortality should be aggregated with spending and infrastructure damage at all.
